providerHomes: Configure providers.template.json locally before applying environment.json. Provider environment variables, login state, endpoints and custom launch arguments are deliberately omitted.
omitted: absolute machine paths and network hostnames
browser profiles, attachments, sessions, logs and usage history
restore: Review and merge these preferences into T3 settings; do not replace the whole userdata directory. Appearance choices are a separate device preference. The encrypted recovery archive preserves original private state.
